lip_mm.how: the lip band's width at the rim's two ends (LIP_MM)

wall_mm.why: the body's wall thickness below the lip (with the glaze); the lip itself is measured (lip_mm); the wall thickens from the lip to this over the upper third

floor_z_mm.why: the inner floor's height above the ground (the base ~5 mm thick over its recessed underside); where the inner wall ends higher, the floor is there

floor_fillet_mm.why: the inner floor turns into the inner wall in a broad curve, as a thrown washer does

base_under_frac.why: the base's underside inside the foot ring, recessed above the ground by this fraction of the ring's measured height

foot_width_mm.why: the foot ring's thickness at its bottom (its inner face is hidden)

bead_mm.why: the foot ring's rounded bottom edge: its bright band in the photo is ~1.5 mm tall (read off by eye, 30 px at 20 px/mm)

foot_top_fillet_mm.why: the crease where the outer wall meets the foot ring's outer face (concave): rounded, as glaze pooled in it would round it

foot_inner_fillets_mm.why: the foot ring's inner edges and the base underside's corner
